issues.description: In the template repository the Bitmap24 class header declares a method named write(const std::string&), but the implementation defines Bitmap24::save(const std::string&) and main.cpp calls bitmap.save(...). This name mismatch between the header, implementation, and call site will cause compilation errors for students using the template. The solution repository consistently uses save(...), so the template's header appears to be incorrect/unintentionally inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header, implementation and usage consistent. Change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from write(...) to save(...), or alternatively rename the implementation and all call sites to write(...). The simplest fix is to update the template header to declare void save(const std::string &i_filename); to match the implementation and main.cpp (and the solution).
